originalTitle: Prince Harry and Meghan ‘moving back to Britain this month’
summary: Reports say Duke and Duchess of Sussex intend to relocate from US, with children to start British school in September
content: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are planning to return to live in Britain, six years after leaving for the US, it has been reported. The couple and their two children, Prince Archie, seven, and Princess Lilibet, five, are expected to relocate later this month to a non-royal residence. The property is believed to be outside London, and the children are enrolled to start school in September, the Daily Telegraph reported. King Charles was informed on Sunday that his son and daughter-in-law would return to Britain, according to the Telegraph. It comes after the Sussexes, who have lived in California since 2020, had a reunion with the king last month at Highgrove in Gloucestershire. The king is said to welcome the opportunity to see more of his family in a personal capacity but there will be no change in their status as private individuals after relinquishing their official working roles within the royal family. The Prince and Princess of Wales are said to have also been informed of the decision. The couple are expected to retain their homes in Montecito, California, and Portugal, where they went on holiday earlier this summer. The duke and duchess’s security arrangements have not been disclosed. The long-running issue over their security meant that Prince Harry did not bring Meghan, 45, or their children to events in London last month, as had been originally planned. Prince Harry, 41, has previously stressed he would not feel safe bringing his family back to the UK without police protection. In May 2025, after losing a legal challenge over his security in the UK, the Duke of Sussex said: “I can’t see a world in which I would bring my wife and children back to the UK at this point.” In an interview with the BBC after the ruling, Prince Harry said he “would love a reconciliation” with the royal family. He said: “There have been so many disagreements between myself and some of my family,” but he had now “forgiven” them. “I would love reconciliation with my family. There’s no point continuing to fight any more, life is precious.” Prince Harry added the dispute over his security had “always been the sticking point”. Asked whether he had asked the king to intervene in the dispute over security, he said: “I never asked him to intervene – I asked him to step out of the way and let the experts do their jobs.” Last month, the Duke of Sussex and six other co-claimants lost their privacy case against the publishers of the Daily Mail in London. The claimants, who included Doreen Lawrence and Elton John, sued Associated Newspapers Ltd over allegations of unlawful information gathering. Their claims were dismissed in their entirety by Mr Justice Nicklin.
chineseTitle: 哈里王子和梅根“本月搬回英国”
chineseSummary: 报道称苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人打算从美国搬迁，孩子们将于九月开始在英国上学
chineseContent: 据报道，苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人计划在前往美国六年后返回英国生活。这对夫妇和他们的两个孩子，七岁的阿奇王子和五岁的莉莉贝特公主，预计将于本月晚些时候搬到一处非王室住所。据《每日电讯报》报道，该房产据信位于伦敦郊外，孩子们将于 9 月入学。据《每日电讯报》报道，查尔斯国王周日获悉，他的儿子和儿媳将返回英国。苏塞克斯夫妇自2020年以来一直居住在加利福尼亚州，上个月在格洛斯特郡的海格罗夫与国王团聚。据说国王很高兴有机会以个人身份见到更多的家人，但在放弃王室的官方工作职责后，他们作为私人的身份不会改变。据说威尔士王子和王妃也已获悉这一决定。这对夫妇预计将保留他们在加利福尼亚州蒙特西托和葡萄牙的家，他们今年夏天早些时候曾在那里度假。公爵和公爵夫人的安全安排尚未披露。长期存在的安全问题意味着哈里王子没有按照原计划带 45 岁的梅根或他们的孩子参加上个月在伦敦举行的活动。 41 岁的哈里王子此前曾强调，如果没有警察的保护，他将无法安全地将家人带回英国。 2025 年 5 月，在有关其在英国安全的法律挑战失败后，苏塞克斯公爵表示：“我现在看不到将我的妻子和孩子带回英国的世界。”哈里王子在裁决后接受 BBC 采访时表示，他“希望能达成和解”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
